notes: Posted 15 November 2001, before Theed Palace (12 December 2001), so the format is Premiere - Reflections III.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting 8': My Lord, Is That Legal?, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Blockade Flagship: Bridge, Fear Is My Ally, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Mobilization Points, They Must Never Again Leave This City; these count toward the 60.

The ten Defensive Shields posted under 'Def Shield 10' sit outside the 60 (the section counts add up to 60 without them); Battle Order, Resistance and Oppressive Enforcement dested the Reflections III shield printings, not the Effects.

The author's updates say this version was posted wrong and point to his second version; the update swaps out Neimoidian Advisor, Bespin, They Must Never Again Leave This City, the Cloud City docking bay and the Oppressive Enforcement shield for Naboo, Endor, the Endor docking bay, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement (new start) and You've Never Won A Race? (shield). The list is kept as first published.

Posted 'Coruscant Galactic Whorehouse' dested Coruscant: Galactic Senate; 'CC DB' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay), the only Dark Cloud City docking bay (the strategy pairs it with Bespin and Aks Moe).

Posted 'Squabble Squabble' dested Squabbling Delegates (the strategy: 'Use Squabble to retrieve'); 'Imp Comm' dested Imperial Command; 'GHHK Combo' dested Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'Lat. Dam.' dested Lateral Damage; 'Neimoid Advisor' dested Neimoidian Advisor.

Posted 'DVDLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Boba In Ship' dested Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Dengar In Ship' dested Dengar In Punishing One; 'Lott Dodd' dested Lott Dod; 'Darth Maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine).
